FAQs

Roofing Questions, Answered

What people want to know before they ring, answered by George and the team.

Time and Booking The Work About Us

Time and Booking

How long will the job take?

A new roof usually takes 2 to 3 days, a flat roof 1 to 2 days, and new uPVC fascias and guttering 1 to 2 days.

How soon can you do it?

That depends on the diary and the weather, so call 07394 136885 and we'll give you a date. If water's coming in, say so when you ring.

What are your opening hours?

We're open 24 hours.

Do you charge for a quote?

No. Quotes are free, with no obligation. Ask for a quote here.

The Work

What roofing work do you do?

Roof repairs, new roofs, flat roofs, tiling and slating, chimney repairs, lead flashing and valleys, and guttering, fascias and soffits. See all our services.

What flat roof materials do you use?

Felt, single ply membrane, GRP fibreglass and Firestone RubberCover EPDM rubber. See flat roofs.

Can you just replace a few tiles?

Yes. We do single broken tiles and slipped slates as well as whole roofs. See roof repairs.

Do you clean gutters and clear moss?

Yes. Gutter cleaning and moss cleaning are both jobs we take on, and we also fit new gutters, fascias and soffits.

About Us

Are you insured?

Yes. We hold £1,000,000 public liability insurance.

Do you give a guarantee?

Yes. We give guarantees of 10, 15, 20 or 25 years.

How long have you been going?

25 years in business. George is the third generation of roofing and building contractors in his family. More on the about page.

Are you on TrustATrader?

Yes. We're vetted and approved, membership number TT23534, and rated 4.96 out of 5 from 53 reviews. Read some of them here.

What areas do you cover?

Sussex and over into Kent, from our base in Burgess Hill. See the areas we cover.

Still Got a Question?

Ask George directly. We're open 24 hours.
